text:
sam: quick check: can we agree stable_id is the canonical routing key and control-plane should return an effective id + remap token when clients pin by name?

ela: yes. stable_id only in runtime. server resolves names and returns headers: X-Effective-Stable-Id, X-Remap-Token, X-Manifest-Fingerprint. clients cache those.

devon: ops asks for remap watermark in the token so invalidation is immediate. also include resolution_ttl_seconds.

sam: minimal metadata example i'll put in RFC: {"stable_id":"sid-12ab","manifest_fingerprint":"sha256:aa11...","remap_token":"rt-20260324-5","resolution_ttl_seconds":300,"fallback_order":["stable_id","manifest_fingerprint","rollback_anchor"]}

ops-bot: reminder: alias remaps must be auditable and rate-limited. enable audit reference `rt-` and log requested_pin + effective_id on every serve.

ela: migration plan: 1) publish stable_id next to names in catalog, 2) auto-resolve legacy name pins for 90 days returning deprecation header, 3) after window require explicit stable_id or force_name_pin=true.

sam: action items: ela write small RFC follow-up with header contract and short client pseudocode; devon draft remap rate-limit + audit rules. closing. :thumbsup:
